svg.title: Chuvor CBT candidate exam screen (mockup)
svg.text: If 3x + 5 = 20, what is the value of x?

svg.title: Candidate sign-in and photo check (mockup)
svg.text: Enter your details to start. Ask the invigilator if you need help.

svg.title: Exam instructions (mockup)
svg.text: Choose one answer for each question. Click it, and it is saved.
Use Next and Previous. Flag a question to come back to it.
The timer is at the top. When it ends, your exam is submitted for you.
If the computer stops, tell the invigilator. Your answers are kept.
Do not leave the exam screen. The invigilator is told if you do.
I have read the instructions and I am ready.

svg.title: Review before submitting (mockup)
svg.text: You cannot change answers after this.
Tip: click a number to go back to that question, then return here.
